purpose: Explicit bounded inputs for method studies when flight-batch engine data are not public.

records.operating_boundary: steady ideal-gas method study; not a flight engine operating point
records.rationale: The public flight configuration identifies engines but does not publish chamber pressure or nozzle area ratio; the range is a numerical study envelope.
records.notes: Do not label outputs as ZQ-3 measured performance. Replace only after a batch-specific source is found.

records.operating_boundary: steady ideal-gas method study; not a flight engine operating point
records.rationale: Public sources give the first-stage engine family, layout and thrust class but not chamber pressure or nozzle area ratio.
records.notes: The two rocket records use the same method envelope for a controlled comparison; this is not evidence that their engines share parameters.

records.rationale: The analytic reference case defines a fixed heat-capacity ratio for software verification.
records.notes: This is not a combustion-gas property.

missing_value_policy: Assumptions are allowed only in explicitly named research scenarios; they cannot overwrite fact records or enter a real-flight parameter set.
